import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
BILLING_DB_PATH = '/srv/billing/billing.db'
HTML_SOURCE_DIR = Path('/srv/billing/invoices/html')
PDF_OUTPUT_DIR = Path('/srv/billing/invoices/active')
SUPERSEDED_DIR = Path('/srv/billing/invoices/superseded')

@function_tool
def render_invoice_pdf(invoice_number: str, paper_size: str='A4') -> dict:
    html_path = HTML_SOURCE_DIR / f'{invoice_number}.html'
    pdf_name = f'{invoice_number}.pdf'
    pdf_path = PDF_OUTPUT_DIR / pdf_name
    page = paper_size if paper_size in ('A4', 'Letter') else 'A4'
    # Move any previously rendered PDF out of the active folder so it is kept as a superseded version
    superseded_path = None
    if pdf_path.exists():
        SUPERSEDED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
        superseded_path = SUPERSEDED_DIR / f'{invoice_number}-{stamp}.pdf'
        shutil.move(str(pdf_path), str(superseded_path))
    proc = subprocess.run(['wkhtmltopdf', '--quiet', '--page-size', page, str(html_path), str(pdf_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    result = {'invoice_number': invoice_number, 'exit_code': proc.returncode}
    if superseded_path is not None:
        result['superseded_pdf_path'] = str(superseded_path)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result.update(ok=False, error=proc.stderr.strip()[-1000:])
        return result
    with sqlite3.connect(BILLING_DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute('UPDATE invoices SET pdf_filename = ?, pdf_rendered_at = ? WHERE invoice_number = ?', (pdf_name, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), invoice_number))
    result.update(ok=True, pdf_path=str(pdf_path), paper_size=page)
    return result
